# Tyll

> Tyll is software for hotels and restaurants that shows where they lose money on stock, waste, bills and invoices, and what to order next. It works read only on top of the POS, PMS, reservations and purchasing systems a hotel or restaurant already runs, and sends a morning brief at 7 AM. Nothing to install and nothing to replace.

## Products

- Log waste: two taps, the item then the amount, log what was wasted or broken, with what it cost.
- Stock levels: worked out from sales, deliveries and logged waste, so you see what runs out first.
- Predictions: one order list grouped by supplier, built from forecast guests, events and the last 4 weeks of use. Nothing is sent until a manager approves it.
- Revenue: revenue and estimated profit, by day and by outlet, with menu performance.
- Reconciliation: bills against kitchen and bar tickets, and supplier invoices against deliveries, so you only see what differs.
- Over pouring: see what was poured but not billed, by outlet and shift, and what it is worth.
